tbpn_example.episode_title: Ellison's counter-offer, Chinese H200s, data centers in space (Aaron Ginn, Matt Kalish, Emil Michael, Blake Scholl, Naveen Rao, Ofir Ehrlich, Gorkem Yurtseven)

notes:
Research: Inversion (Jacobi's 'invert, always invert'; Munger's 'all I want to know is where I'm going to die, so I'll never go there') plus Gary Klein's pre-mortem, HBR September 2007. Klein's five steps: know the plan; assert the fiasco ('it is a year later and the project has failed'); each member independently writes every reason; consolidate; revisit the plan and engineer safeguards. Mechanism is prospective hindsight (Mitchell, Russo and Pennington 1989: imagining an outcome as already realised raises the ability to name correct reasons by about 30%). It differs from a risk register because failure is asserted as fact, which licenses concrete narrative and lets dissenters speak without disloyalty.

Provenance consequence, decided here: the source gives the plan and the visible risks (goal and most causes are facts); the inversion, the pathways and every safeguard are LLM reasoning. Idea-bearing slot is safeguard: a missing safeguard is often a product someone could sell. Three of the four TBPN safeguards carry an idea (s_parts, s_bond, s_permit).

Graph verification pass (step 4, after the writing agent was interrupted). Validator: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Changes made in this pass, all before the scaffold commit:
- s_firewall label was 41 characters (the one warning); shortened to 'Ring-fence airliner from turbine cash' (37), meaning preserved.
- Edge fe1 (p_ramp rests_on c_demand) was marked fact but its quote was only c_demand's own assertion; the speaker never states that the ramp depends on the demand, and the two claims sit ~180 lines apart. Reclassified derived at 0.70 per SPEC 3 ('a sequence read from narrative order' is derived). The remaining five TBPN fact edges each contain a real connective in one turn ('the capital to go do that', 'So we're done fundraising', 'copy paste into the facility that will do 2 gigawatts', 'it literally prints the cash').
- Classic fact edges kf5 and kf6 had enclosing spans rather than connectives; both extended to start at 'The director notes three things for the record:' so the clause that attaches the condition to the plan is inside the quote. Still verbatim.
- c_permits: node text said 'the biggest problem with building anything physical'; the speaker says 'a huge problem' and 'much bigger than energy production'. Text corrected and source_ref widened to L4576-L4606, which is where 'such huge delays and huge costs' actually sits.

Confidence discipline, the thing most at risk in this framework. Rule applied and held: no pathway anywhere in the library sits above 0.65, because a pathway is a constructed narrative even when its ingredients are quoted. k_p1 was lowered 0.70 -> 0.65 (and its edge ke2 with it) because it adds three unstated steps to one stated condition. path_customer sits at 0.55 because the source explicitly denies demand risk. The assumed failure 'fail' was lowered 0.75 -> 0.70 (and edge te1 with it): the inversion is mandated by the method, but the 2028 date and the ordering of the collapse are a judgement. Safeguards are split on a principle: a safeguard that is the direct inversion of an explicitly named gap sits at 0.70-0.75 (k_s1 volume test, k_s2 retention, k_s3 abort criteria), while a safeguard that invents a mechanism nobody mentioned sits at 0.55-0.65 (s_bond, s_permit, s_parts, s_firewall). Every TBPN safeguard is in the lower band, which is correct: none of them is in the source.

One deliberate asymmetry between the examples. In the classic, k_fiasco is a fact node in the assumed_failure slot, because the source is itself a pre-mortem: the director asserts the fiasco out loud. In the TBPN example the same slot is derived, because Scholl does the opposite of a pre-mortem on camera ('basically inevitable'). The pair is the point of the framework page: it shows what the slot looks like when the room has run the exercise and when it has not.

Registry deviation: added relation 'rests_on' beyond the registry's four, for the dependency a source states about its own plan. Without it the goal-to-cause links have no relation to use and every one of them would have to be derived, which would hide the fact skeleton this framework is supposed to expose. Registry slot ids are unchanged.
